items.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Force UK Power Plant Offline in Unprecedented Four-Day Cyberattack
items.description: A cyberattack attributed to hackers linked to Iran forced a British power plant offline for four consecutive days last month, marking what officials describe as the first successful attack of its kind against UK energy infrastructure. items.title: How an Emerging Industrial Protocol Family Could Put OT at Risk
items.description: New research shows how attacks against some unprotected TSN protocols could allow attackers to disrupt or manipulate physical processes.

items.title: Hardware Makers Implement Post-Quantum Cryptography as Security Threats Near
items.description: The coming threat of super-powerful computers capable of cracking today’s algorithms requires upgrading encryption now. Tech companies have begun building defenses.
